welcomeText: A new patch of the night sky awaits your discovery. Find the pattern among the stars and connect them in the order you believe is right.
title: NOVEMBER'S LATE AUTUMN SKY
subheading: Connect the stars · Trust your observation
skyUpdate:
I rise from ashes, yet I am no flame.
I bear the memory of an endless cycle.
Far beneath the northern skies, I spread my wings.
My name belongs to a bird reborn through fire.
Tell me, Observer, which constellation am I?
